# Codex pets 宠物（线条小狗 Maltese & Golden Retriever）

将文件夹放入~/.codex/pets目录下，然后在Codex → 设置 → 外观 → 宠物 中选择  
Extract it into ~/.codex/pets, Select the pet in Codex → Settings → Appearance → Pets  

*图片由AI生成，小白和小黄都有部分瑕疵*  
*Images were generated by AI, both the white and yellow images have some imperfections*
